title: Four moves that turn a PM brief into shippable code

items.title: Frame the outcome
items.body: One sentence. Who benefits, what changes for them, how you'll know it shipped.

items.title: Name the constraints
items.body: Budget, deadline, risk tolerance, things the team has already ruled out.

items.title: Draft the slice
items.body: Smallest real thing that proves the outcome. No scaffolding, no side quests.

items.title: Write the acceptance test
items.body: The exact check the agent's output must pass. Write it before prompting.
